story: Marcus's bike crash, seen in UCSF's emergency department (CT head, neck and abdomen, X-rays, wound repair, splint), rebuilt from UCSF's real price file. High-deductible plan, household of 3 at about 152% of the poverty line. His share is over 10% of his income, so UCSF's own policy writes it off: free care.

eob_basis.allowed_statistic: median of the payer-specific dollar rates the hospital's file lists for the code (price table field `negotiated_median_of_payers`) x billed units
eob_basis.fallback_statistic: the file lists no payer rate for this code: estimated as gross x this hospital's median (payer median / gross) ratio across every code in its table that has both
eob_basis.order: deductible first, then coinsurance on the rest, line by line in bill order, capped at the out-of-pocket max; coinsurance rounded half up to the cent per line
